keyPhrases.text: should find pleasure, and even food for thought
fans of the Comedy Central standby will feel right at home

reasoning: Strong positive review with clear recommendation that audiences will find pleasure and laughs. Praises Hayes' performance balance, set design as 'impressive,' and assures both faithful and nonbelievers will enjoy it. Has one notable criticism about strained seriousness in the latter half, but overall tone is enthusiastic and recommendatory.
